scope: Source-backed local control specification; existing unit failures exercised, no actual pager delivery or live SLA claimed.

alerts.name: Deposit halt / dirty persistence barrier
alerts.signal: system snapshot deposit state halted/paused; deposits.halt/dirty/check_ready
alerts.action: Stop new credits/broadcast; retain cursor, route and snapshot; reconcile finalized prefix.
alerts.evidence: workspace-integrated: deposit_ingestion tests with failed ACK/finalized reorg/retry
alerts.threshold: Any durable halt; paused age threshold requires operational baseline

alerts.name: Snapshot or journal persistence failure
alerts.signal: [state] snapshot write failed; stage-1/stage-2 rollback journal is not durable
alerts.action: Preserve old file; refuse confirmed response/broadcast; repair storage and retry owned fixture.
alerts.evidence: snapshot S3 filesystem cases; journal-guard ENOTDIR/ENAMETOOLONG cases

alerts.name: Settlement failure/HELD
alerts.action: Investigate prover/RPC/durable state; do not automatically force resume or reset snapshot.
alerts.evidence: settle_health unit cases: 3rd failure held, once-per-episode alert, cap, success rearm
alerts.threshold: Configured FIN_HELD_THRESHOLD; source default 3, not an SLA

alerts.name: Oracle stale or inconsistent
alerts.signal: core freshness/confidence/deviation rejection; configured oracle feed
alerts.action: Keep risk-increasing operations closed; inspect signer/time/source disagreement.
alerts.evidence: native oracle/core fixtures only; no end-to-end injected operational alarm
alerts.threshold: Market risk parameters; no arbitrary pager latency assigned

alerts.name: Vault/engine reconciliation
alerts.signal: Credited deposit prefix, uncredited finalized leaves, token balance, outstanding claims, bond, engine internal_value
alerts.action: Stop release on unexplained difference; compare one pinned block and exact engine source/state.
alerts.evidence: native accounting / Foundry controls, not real-proof integrated ledger
